run_markdown_cli: run the markdown CLI module to convert a markdown file to HTML output
parse_options_markdown: parse command-line options for the markdown CLI including extensions and output format
run_markdown_with_extensions: run the markdown CLI with custom extensions loaded via the extension flag
parse_extension_configs: parse extension configuration from a JSON or YAML config file for markdown extensions
run_markdown_from_stdin: run the markdown CLI to convert markdown input from STDIN to HTML output
